title: Dental tourism in Albania: how a trip works | European Dental
description: What a dental trip to Durrës involves: a written plan from your x-ray before you travel, how many visits it takes, where you stay, and how the price is set.

intro.h2: Treatment in Durrës, arranged from home
p: We put patients in touch with certified clinics in Durrës, on the Albanian coast, and arrange the practical side of the trip. Most people who write to us live in Germany, Italy or Switzerland and have already been quoted for the same work at home.
Nothing is decided before you have something to read. The first step is a written plan, and the comparison is yours to make.

plan.h3: A written plan before you book anything
p: Send a recent panoramic x-ray and a few photographs of your teeth. If you do not have an x-ray, any dental practice can take one, and many will email it to you the same day.

A dentist in Durrës reads it and writes back with what the work would involve, in what order, and what it would cost. That document is yours, and you are welcome to take it to your own dentist for a second opinion.
items: A panoramic x-ray, and photographs if you have them
A written treatment plan, listing the work step by step
The number of visits, and how long each stay needs to be
The price for the plan as written
after: No deposit is asked for at this stage and no appointment is held.

trip.h3: Durrës, and how long you are there
p: Durrës is on the coast, about forty minutes by road from Tirana airport, which is reached by direct flights from several German and Italian cities. The clinic is in the city itself.

Implant work usually needs two trips with healing in between, often three to six months apart. Crowns, veneers and fillings are generally one trip. Your plan says which applies before you book a flight.
items: Transfers between Tirana airport and the clinic
Help finding a room near the clinic
Appointments grouped so the stay is as short as the work allows
Someone who speaks your language with you at the appointments
after: Flights stay in your hands, so the airline, the dates and the fare are yours to choose.

quality.h2: Who treats you, and with what
quality.h3: The materials are named in the plan
p: The plan names the implant system and the ceramic, rather than calling them high quality. They are the same names used in German and Italian practices, and you can look both up before you travel.
The clinic takes its own 3D scans on site, which is what allows a plan to be written from measurements instead of from an estimate.
items: The implant system and the ceramic, named in writing
3D imaging taken at the clinic
The name of the dentist who will carry out the work
Written aftercare instructions, and the warranty terms where one applies
after: Ask for anything on that list your plan does not already state.

costs.h3: Per plan, not per price list
p: There is no price list on this page. A single crown and a full arch are not the same job, and neither is a mouth that needs preparatory work first.
The written plan carries one price for the work described in it. If the dentist finds something on the day that changes the plan, the change is quoted before it is carried out.
items: One price for the plan as written
Any change quoted before the work, not after
What is included and what is not, stated in the document
after: Whether the journey is worth it is a comparison only you can make, with both quotes in front of you.

why.h2: What we do, and what we do not
items: We arrange the plan, the appointments and the transfers
We interpret for you at the appointments
We quote nothing before a dentist has read your x-ray
We promise no result, and no honest clinic will
We say so when the answer is that you are better treated at home
p: Send it and we will come back with a plan and a price. If the plan does not convince you, you have lost nothing but an email.
after: We answer in German, Italian, English and Albanian.
